description: This PHP source file defines the RecruitmentAttachmentDao class, which manages data access operations related to recruitment attachments such as vacancy, candidate, and interview attachments within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It provides methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and listing attachments, including filtering and authorization checks.

classes.name: RecruitmentAttachmentDao
classes.description: A data access object class responsible for managing CRUD operations and complex queries related to recruitment attachments in the HRM system.

methods.name: saveVacancyAttachment
methods.description: Persists a VacancyAttachment entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: saveCandidateAttachment
methods.description: Persists a CandidateAttachment entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: saveInterviewAttachment
methods.description: Persists an InterviewAttachment entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentById
methods.description: Retrieves a VacancyAttachment by its ID, returns null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingVacancyAttachmentIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of existing VacancyAttachments from a list of IDs.

methods.name: getPartialCandidateAttachmentByCandidateId
methods.description: Returns a partial RecruitmentAttachment DTO for a candidate's attachment based on candidate ID.

methods.name: getCandidateAttachmentByCandidateId
methods.description: Retrieves a CandidateAttachment entity based on candidate ID.

methods.name: hasCandidateAttachmentByCandidateId
methods.description: Checks whether a candidate has any attachment associated with their ID.

methods.name: getPartialInterviewAttachmentByAttachmentIdAndInterviewId
methods.description: Returns a partial RecruitmentAttachment DTO for an interview attachment matched by attachment and interview IDs.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentByAttachmentIdAndInterviewId
methods.description: Retrieves an InterviewAttachment entity by attachment ID and interview ID.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentsByVacancyId
methods.description: Fetches all vacancy attachments associated with a specific vacancy ID.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentsCountByVacancyId
methods.description: Returns the number of attachments linked to a specific vacancy.

methods.name: deleteVacancyAttachments
methods.description: Deletes multiple vacancy attachments based on their IDs.

methods.name: deleteCandidateAttachment
methods.description: Deletes a candidate's attachment based on candidate ID.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves a list of interview attachments filtered by search parameters.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentCount
methods.description: Counts the number of interview attachments matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of all ID numbers of interview attachments.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of all ID numbers of vacancy attachments.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachmentListForHiringManger
methods.description: Fetches attachment IDs associated with vacancies managed by a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentListForHiringManger
methods.description: Fetches attachment IDs linked to vacancies managed by a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: getInterviewAttachmentListForInterviewer
methods.description: Fetches attachment IDs accessible to an interviewer based on assigned interviews.

methods.name: getAccessibleInterviewIdsForInterviewer
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of interviews accessible to a specified interviewer.

methods.name: getExistingInterviewAttachmentIdsForInterview
methods.description: Fetches IDs of interview attachments that exist for a given list of IDs and interview ID.

methods.name: deleteInterviewAttachments
methods.description: Deletes specified interview attachments associated with an interview.
